build_Trainer: build a Trainer instance with source/target embeddings, mapping, discriminator, and training parameters
run_dis_step: run a discriminator training step that computes binary cross-entropy loss and updates discriminator weights
run_mapping_step: run a mapping training step that fools the discriminator and orthogonalizes the mapping matrix
run_procrustes: run the Orthogonal Procrustes algorithm to find the best orthogonal mapping matrix via SVD
run_export: run the export method to map source embeddings to target space and write them to disk
